doc:
A mark that could not be written must not leave `undo` acting on an older turn's mark. Three arms,
        each a fresh kernel: (a) no mark has ever existed and `runtime/` is read-only; (b) a stale mark from
        turn one with the mark file unwritable and its folder writable; (c) the same with the folder read-only,
        where the fix's own `remove_file` cannot land. qal-j10's shape, #444's fix.

breaks.detail: arm (b, mark folder writable): the mark could not be rewritten at turn two's start, and `undo` reset to e5f5145dc04d — turn one's commit e71661777b9f is unreachable and a.txt is gone. The mark said e5f5145dc04d; `undo` reported ['restored e5f5145dc04ddcaf3eb1c586c835c656b264c61e']
breaks.where: arbos-engine tools/git.rs snapshot_turn_tree — a mark that cannot be written is removed, and `undo` with no mark refuses (#444)

breaks.detail: arm (b): `undo` neither restored to turn two's start nor said why it refused — HEAD e5f5145dc04d, said ['restored e5f5145dc04ddcaf3eb1c586c835c656b264c61e']

arm (c, mark folder read-only): the mark could not be rewritten at turn two's start, and `undo` reset to e5f5145dc04d — turn one's commit dbe63865f39a is unreachable and a.txt is gone. The mark said e5f5145dc04d; `undo` reported ['restored e5f5145dc04ddcaf3eb1c586c835c656b264c61e']
breaks.where: arbos-engine tools/git.rs snapshot_turn_tree — a mark that cannot be written is removed, and `undo` with no mark refuses (#444)

breaks.detail: arm (c): `undo` neither restored to turn two's start nor said why it refused — HEAD e5f5145dc04d, said ['restored e5f5145dc04ddcaf3eb1c586c835c656b264c61e']
